viewport.baseNote: Base model: can't be edited here. Edit it in the base project.

meshEdit.title: Mesh: {{mesh}}
meshEdit.hint: Drag: move / box select · Shift: add · Ctrl+click: add vertex · Del: remove · Esc: exit

cell.notOnKey: Not on a key: editing would not know which cell to write.

toggle.label: Form edit
toggle.tooltip: Edit the keyform of the current cell

originAllCells.label: Origin: all cells
originAllCells.tooltip: Move the origin in every cell and keep the children in place (or hold Shift)

glue.addHint: Click a vertex of each mesh to pair them
glue.removeHint: Click the square on a pair to remove it

add.label: Add pairs
add.tooltip: Pair a vertex of each mesh by clicking them

remove.label: Remove pairs
remove.tooltip: Remove a pair by clicking its square

addPart.label: + Part
addPart.tooltip: Add a part under the selected part

base.label: base
base.tooltip: Part of the base model: read-only in a module project

mask.label: mask
mask.tooltip: Mask only: not drawn as color

hidden.label: hidden
hidden.tooltip: Opacity is 0 at the default parameter values

drop.hint: Drop onto a part, a deformer or between meshes
drop.partInto: A part can only be moved into another part
drop.cycle: Cannot move {{what}} into itself or its descendant
drop.deformerNeedsPart: A deformer must belong to a part
drop.deformerInto: A deformer can only be moved into a part or another deformer
drop.meshNeedsPart: A mesh must belong to a part
drop.meshInto: A mesh can only be moved into a part or a deformer
drop.notMovable: A {{kind}} cannot be moved in the tree
drop.otherMesh: Drop onto another mesh to reorder
drop.drawOrder: {{what}} (draw order {{a}}) and {{target}} (draw order {{b}}) cannot be reordered: change the draw order instead (Inspector > Draw order)
drop.ontoMesh: Drop onto a mesh to reorder
drop.oneMesh: Reorder one mesh at a time
drop.moveToPartFirst: Drop onto the part to move the mesh first
drop.moveToDeformerFirst: Drop onto the deformer to move the mesh first

parameters.title: Parameters

snap.label: Snap to keys
snap.tooltip: Move the selected element's parameters to their nearest keys

add.moduleNote: A module can't add parameters. Add them in the base project and expose them in the slot.

edit.tooltipRelay: Edit {{id}} (relay parameter: tracking does not write it, and viewers hide it)

relay.label: Relay (internal)
relay.description: A relay parameter passes values between physics rigs. Tracking does not write it, and viewers hide it by default.

value.tooltip: Type a value between {{min}} and {{max}}, then press Enter

key.base: The selected element belongs to the base model. Edit it in the base project.

parameters.baseHint: Parameters belong to the base model and can't be edited here. Edit them in the base project.

mirror.label: Mirror
mirror.tooltip: The parameter on the other side (used when mirroring keyforms). Pairs are set on both parameters.

timeline.keyBlocked: A key cannot be moved past its neighbor.

linear.label: Linear
linear.description: Make the segment into this key a straight line

bezier.label: Bezier
bezier.description: Make the segment into this key a bezier curve with handles

stepped.label: Step
stepped.description: Make the segment into this key a step at this key

inverseStepped.label: Inv. step
inverseStepped.description: Make the segment into this key a step right after the previous key

motion.nameInvalid: Use letters, digits, _, - and . (not starting with .) in motion names.

repeat.label: Repeat
repeat.description: Repeat the playback from the start (the motion's Loop also repeats)

keyChanged.label: ◆ Key changed
keyChanged.tooltip: Key every parameter whose slider differs from the motion at this time
keyChanged.nothing: No parameter differs from the motion at this time. Move a slider first.

ruler.tooltip: Click or drag to seek (Shift: without snapping to frames)

keyRow.tooltip: Key {{id}} at {{time}} s with its slider value

motion.empty: No motions yet. Press “New motion”, then key the sliders over time.

curve.firstKey: The first key has no segment before it.
curve.hintKey: Click a key to edit it. Double-click the graph to add one.
curve.hintEmpty: No curve yet. Press ◆ or double-click the graph to key.

fade.tooltip: Fade of this curve (empty: the motion's fade)

delete.label: Delete curve
delete.tooltip: Delete this curve and all its keys

handleStart.aria: Start handle of the segment into {{time}}

handleEnd.aria: End handle of the segment into {{time}}

new.label: New from sliders
new.tooltip: Create an expression from the sliders moved away from their defaults

expression.nothingMoved: Move some sliders away from their defaults first.
expression.nameInvalid: Use letters, digits, _, - and . (not starting with .) in expression names.

preview.label: Preview
preview.tooltip: Show the expression over the current sliders (press again to restore them)

fromSliders.label: Set values from sliders
fromSliders.tooltip: Recompute the values from the current sliders (keeping each operation)

expression.empty: No expressions yet. Move the sliders to make a face, then press “New from sliders”.
